manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Simulates a grid predictive-maintenance pipeline — telemetry scoring, failure ranking, work-order and capex drafts — from seeded synthetic demo data.
manifest.name: @kody-w/predictive_asset_maintenance_intelligence

asset_class.description: Restrict the run to a single asset class.

asset_ids.description: Specific asset IDs to run. If omitted, a synthetic fleet sample is used.

current_fiscal_year.description: Current FY for the capex pipeline. Defaults to current year.

sample_size.description: Fleet sample size when asset_ids is omitted. Defaults to 25.

substation.description: Restrict the run to a single substation (e.g. SUB-44).

top_n.description: How many ranked assets to carry forward. Defaults to 25.

work_order_threshold.description: Failure-probability threshold for drafting work orders (0.0-1.0). Defaults to 0.30.
